questions.stance: What is your position on the ORIGINAL proposal as described?
questions.reasons_opposed: Which aspects make this proposal unacceptable to you?
questions.reasons_supported: Do you have any reservations or conditions, or do you accept the proposal as described?
questions.reasons_uncertain: Which aspects are you unsure about, or what information would you need?
questions.reasons_mixed: Which aspects do you accept, and which would require changes?
questions.topic: For {topic}, what specifically matters to you, what is your position on the ORIGINAL proposal, and does acceptance depend on a change?
questions.changes: For {topic}, could any change make that aspect acceptable to you? If so, what would need to change?
questions.blocker: For {topic}: would this issue alone make the ORIGINAL proposal unacceptable, even if your other concerns were addressed?
questions.unmapped: You mentioned ‘{topic}’. What specifically matters to you about this issue, and would it affect acceptance of the ORIGINAL proposal?

choice_labels.mixed: I accept some aspects; others need changes
choice_labels.no_reservations: I accept the proposal as described, with no reservations or conditions

note: Extension of FN evidence collection. Topic selection is not stance, severity or a score. Blockers are citizen boundaries, not numerical bottleneck rules. Silence remains unknown.

topic_choice_labels.mixed: I accept some parts; others need changes
topic_choice_labels.uncertain: I am unsure about this aspect
